info.name: UPI Analyzer API — Regression Suite
info.description: Functional, negative, security and data-isolation tests for the UPI Analyzer Express API. Run in order (folders 01 → 09). Every run creates fresh users, so it can be repeated.

exec: // common check for every request: no stack traces leak to the client
pm.test("Status is 404", () => pm.response.to.have.status(404));pm.test("Error message: Route not found", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().detail).to.eql("Route not found"));
// 🎲 every run uses a fresh email so the suite can run again and again

item.name: Token signed with a wrong secret → 401

exec: // 🕵️ attacker copies a real user id but signs with their own secret
pm.collectionVariables.set("forgedToken", sign({ sub: claims.sub, email: claims.email }, "attacker-secret"));

pm.test("Status is 401", () => pm.response.to.have.status(401));pm.test("Error message: Invalid or expired token. Please login again.", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().detail).to.eql("Invalid or expired token. Please login again."));

item.name: Failed uploads did not touch saved data

exec: pm.test("4 rows in upload order", () => pm.expect(t.map(r => r.description.slice(0, 6))).to.eql(["SWIGGY", "SALARY", "UBER T", "DDDDDD"]));
pm.test("Text amount \"120\" is stored as number 120", () => pm.expect(t[2].debit).to.eql(120));
pm.test("Type is derived from debit/credit", () => pm.expect(t.map(r => r.type)).to.eql(["Debit", "Credit", "Debit", "Debit"]));
pm.test("Only the salary", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().transactions.map(r => r.description)).to.eql(["SALARY ACME TECH"]));

item.name: Regex characters in search are treated as text

exec: pm.test("Categories sorted by spend", () => pm.expect(s.byCategory.map(c => c.category)).to.eql(["Food", "Travel", "Others"]));
pm.test("Income is not a spending category", () => pm.expect(s.byCategory.map(c => c.category)).to.not.include("Income"));
pm.test("Months add up to the total", () => pm.expect(s.byMonth.reduce((a, m) => a + m.spent, 0)).to.eql(s.totalSpent));
